learn.title: Authorizing access to Azure and on-premises resources
objectives: Design Azure RBAC with built-in or custom roles at the narrowest scope that meets the need, using groups to stay within role assignment limits
Tell Microsoft Entra roles (directory) apart from Azure roles (resources) and choose Privileged Identity Management for just-in-time access
Choose Azure Lighthouse for cross-tenant management and separate control-plane from data-plane authorization for Storage, Key Vault and Cosmos DB
Prefer Microsoft Entra authorization over keys and shared access signatures, and use ABAC conditions to narrow storage access
Give users secure access to on-premises resources with Microsoft Entra application proxy, Private Access, Entra Domain Services and Azure Arc
concepts: Azure RBAC

Authorization system for Azure resources: a role assignment joins a security principal, a role definition and a scope (management group, subscription, resource group or resource). Assignments are additive and inherited downwards.
Control plane vs data plane

Control-plane permissions (Actions) manage the resource through Azure Resource Manager; data-plane permissions (DataActions) read or write the data inside it, such as blobs, secrets or Cosmos DB items.
Custom role
A role definition you create when no built-in role fits least privilege. It lists Actions, NotActions, DataActions and AssignableScopes; NotActions only subtract from that role and are not a deny.
Deny assignment
Blocks specific actions for principals even if a role assignment grants them. You do not create them directly; Azure creates them for features such as managed applications and deployment stacks.
Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
Microsoft Entra ID P2 / ID Governance feature that makes Entra and Azure role assignments eligible or time-bound, with activation requiring MFA, justification or approval.
Azure Lighthouse
Delegated resource management: a customer projects subscriptions or resource groups to users, groups or service principals in a managing tenant, without guest accounts. Owner cannot be delegated.
ABAC role assignment condition
An extra check on a role assignment, for example only blobs with a given index tag, container name or a principal attribute that matches; supported for Blob Storage, Data Lake Storage and Queues.
User delegation SAS
A shared access signature signed with a key obtained by a Microsoft Entra identity instead of the account key; valid for up to 7 days and limited by the signer's own RBAC permissions.
Microsoft Entra application proxy
Publishes on-premises web apps (HTTP/HTTPS) through outbound-only connectors, with Entra pre-authentication, Conditional Access and SSO such as Kerberos constrained delegation or header-based.
Microsoft Entra Private Access
Global Secure Access service that replaces VPN for any TCP/UDP private app (RDP, SMB, SSH), using the Global Secure Access client and the same connectors as application proxy.
Microsoft Entra Domain Services
Managed domain with LDAP, Kerberos, NTLM, domain join and Group Policy, synchronised one way from Entra ID; no Domain Admin rights and no schema extensions.
Azure Arc-enabled servers
Projects on-premises and other-cloud servers into Azure as resources, so Azure RBAC, Azure Policy, managed identities and Entra-based sign-in apply to them.
comparisons: Microsoft Entra roles vs Azure roles

Entra roles (Global Administrator, User Administrator) manage the directory and can be scoped to administrative units. Azure roles (Owner, Contributor) manage resources at management group to resource scope. Neither grants the other, except that a Global Administrator can elevate to User Access Administrator at root scope.
Azure Lighthouse vs B2B guest accounts

Lighthouse suits service providers and central IT managing many tenants at scale with no guest accounts and customer-visible delegations. A B2B guest suits a few people needing access in one tenant, and is needed for Entra directory roles, which Lighthouse does not cover.
Account key / SAS vs Entra authorization

Account keys give full access and cannot be scoped. Service and account SAS are signed with the key; a stored access policy lets you revoke a service SAS. User delegation SAS and Entra RBAC avoid keys, so you can disallow Shared Key authorization.

Application proxy publishes web apps with per-app SSO and is included with Entra ID P1. Private Access covers any TCP/UDP protocol, needs the Global Secure Access client and a Private Access licence, and replaces broad VPN access.
Entra Domain Services vs AD DS on Azure VMs

Domain Services is managed and needs no domain controllers, but has no Domain Admin rights and no schema extensions. Domain controllers on VMs extending on-premises AD give full control and schema changes but you run and patch them.

Start with built-in roles; create custom roles only when a built-in role grants too much or too little. There is a limit of 5000 custom roles per tenant, and a custom role with DataActions cannot be assigned at management group scope.
traps: Owner or Contributor on a storage account, vault or Cosmos DB account does not grant data-plane access through Entra authorization; you also need a data role such as Storage Blob Data Reader.
NotActions is not a deny: another role assignment that grants the action still allows it, because Azure RBAC is additive.
A subscription Owner cannot assign Microsoft Entra roles, and a Global Administrator does not get access to subscriptions until they elevate access.
Azure Lighthouse cannot delegate the Owner role, and User Access Administrator is only for assigning roles to managed identities.
Application proxy only publishes HTTP/HTTPS apps; RDP, SMB and SSH to private servers need Microsoft Entra Private Access.
Cloud-only users cannot sign in to an Entra Domain Services managed domain until they change their password so the needed password hashes are generated.
revision: Assign roles to groups at the narrowest scope that works; there is a limit of 4000 role assignments per subscription.
Use PIM eligible assignments with MFA and approval instead of standing Owner or Global Administrator rights.
Use Azure Lighthouse for MSPs and multi-tenant operations; customers can remove a delegation at any time.
Choose data roles (Storage Blob Data, Key Vault Secrets User, Cosmos DB built-in data roles) for apps, and disable key-based access where possible.
Prefer user delegation SAS; use stored access policies when service SAS tokens must be revocable.
Use ABAC conditions on blob index tags or container names to cut down the number of role assignments.
Application proxy with Kerberos constrained delegation gives SSO to on-premises Integrated Windows Authentication apps without a VPN.
Onboard on-premises servers to Azure Arc so the same RBAC, policy and managed identity model applies everywhere.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for authorizing access to Azure resources
questions.q: You are designing Azure RBAC for a company. What is the narrowest scope at which you can assign an Azure role?
opts: A subscription containing the resource group
A management group containing the subscription
An individual resource, such as a single storage account
A resource group containing the resource
questions.e: Azure RBAC scopes are management group, subscription, resource group and resource. Permissions assigned at a higher scope are inherited by lower scopes.

opts: Assign a Microsoft Entra role such as Helpdesk Administrator
Assign the User Access Administrator Azure role at root scope
Assign the Owner Azure role at the subscription scope
Assign the Contributor Azure role at the tenant root group
questions.e: Password resets are directory tasks, controlled by Microsoft Entra roles. Azure roles only control Azure resources.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for authorizing access to Azure resources
questions.q: True or false: if a custom role lists an operation in NotActions, a user with that role can never perform the operation, even if another role assignment grants it.
opts: True; NotActions works as a deny across all assignments
False; NotActions only removes the operation from that one role
False; NotActions applies only to data-plane operations
True; but only when both roles are at the same scope
questions.e: Azure RBAC is additive. NotActions subtracts permissions from that role definition only; it is not a deny assignment.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions

questions.q: A company requires every request to a storage account to be authorized with Microsoft Entra ID so it can be tied to an identity. Existing apps already use data roles. What should you recommend next?

Disallow Shared Key authorization on the storage account
Regenerate both storage account keys every 30 days
Add a private endpoint and disable public network access
questions.e: With Shared Key disallowed, account keys and SAS signed with them are rejected; only Entra authorization and user delegation SAS work.

questions.q: A container holds documents for many projects. Each blob has a Project index tag. The Alpha team must read only blobs tagged Project=Alpha, and the company does not want to move blobs into separate containers. What should you recommend?
opts: Reader on the storage account plus a SAS for each Alpha blob
Storage Blob Data Reader on the container with a stored access policy
Storage Blob Data Reader with a condition on the Project blob index tag
A custom role with NotDataActions for blobs of other projects
questions.e: Attribute-based access control conditions on role assignments can filter access by blob index tags, container names and other attributes.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for authorizing access to on-premises resources
questions.q: An on-premises app is published through application proxy. Unauthenticated traffic must never reach the app, and a Conditional Access policy requiring MFA must apply. Which setting should you recommend?
opts: Microsoft Entra ID pre-authentication
Translate URLs in headers
Passthrough pre-authentication
Use HTTP-only cookie
questions.e: With Entra ID pre-authentication, users authenticate to Entra ID before traffic is sent to the app, so Conditional Access applies. Passthrough sends traffic without authentication.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for authorizing access to Azure resources
questions.q: A service provider evaluates Azure Lighthouse. Which statements are true? 1) The Owner role can be delegated to the provider's group. 2) The customer can remove the delegation at any time. 3) Provider engineers need guest accounts in the customer tenant.
opts: Statements 1 and 2 only
Statement 2 only
Statements 1, 2 and 3

questions.e: Lighthouse does not support the Owner role, and engineers work from their own tenant without guest accounts. Customers can remove delegations.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions
questions.on: Recommend a solution for authorizing access to Azure resources
questions.q: Fifty project teams share a container, and blobs carry a Project index tag. Each user must read only blobs of their own project. Users move between projects often, and you must minimise the number of role assignments. What should you recommend?
opts: A separate container per project with Storage Blob Data Reader per group
A user delegation SAS per project, refreshed when users change project
One Storage Blob Data Reader assignment per project with a tag condition per group
One conditioned assignment that matches a user's Project custom security attribute to the blob tag
questions.e: ABAC conditions can compare a principal's custom security attribute with a resource attribute, so one assignment can cover every project.

questions.dom: Design identity, governance, and monitoring solutions

Move the DataActions into the Actions section of the role
Add the root management group instead of the child group
